original_prompt: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Write a CloudFormation template provisioning an ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal Network Load Balancer.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: ECS Fargate cluster running two microservices behind an internal NLB

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC where resources will be deployed
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Private subnets for ECS tasks and internal NLB (minimum 2 in different AZs)
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues: [development, staging, production]
  ServiceAImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service A
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable
  ServiceBImage:
    Type: String
    Description: Container image URI for Service B
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable
  ServiceAPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8080
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
  ServiceBPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8081
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
  ServiceADesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  ServiceBDesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
  TaskCpu:
    Type: String
    Default: '512'
    AllowedValues: ['256', '512', '1024', '2048', '4096']
  TaskMemory:
    Type: String
    Default: '1024'
    AllowedValues: ['512', '1024', '2048', '4096', '8192']
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
  AllowedClientCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR allowed to reach the internal NLB (typically VPC CIDR)
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$

Resources:

  # ---------- ECS Cluster ----------
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-cluster
      CapacityProviders: [FARGATE, FARGATE_SPOT]
      DefaultCapacityProviderStrategy:
        - CapacityProvider: FARGATE
          Weight: 1
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------- IAM Roles ----------
  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-task-execution-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceATaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-service-a-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ServiceBTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-service-b-task-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------- CloudWatch Log Groups ----------
  ServiceALogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-a
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ServiceBLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /ecs/${AWS::StackName}/service-b
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  # ---------- Security Groups ----------
  NlbSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the internal NLB
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          ToPort: !Ref ServiceAPort
          CidrIp: !Ref AllowedClientCidr
          Description: Allow client traffic to Service A
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ServiceBPort
